exposure: Survivors of CNS and renal tumors
CCSs treated with lower abdominal/pelvic radiotherapy
Specific cancer diagnoses (CNS tumors, renal tumors)
Women who ever had the desire to become pregnant
cohort: 1095 female childhood cancer survivors (CCSs) and 812 controls (sisters of CCSs and a random sample of women from the general population) in the Netherlands
finding: Childhood cancer survivors (CCSs) were less likely to have ever been pregnant, had longer time to pregnancy, and were at increased risk of preterm delivery and cesarean section, particularly those treated with lower abdominal/pelvic radiotherapy.
mod_finding: CCSs, especially those treated with lower abdominal/pelvic radiotherapy, were more likely to deliver preterm and via cesarean section.
